spec_match.rationale: Calls getPathSegmentAtLength() directly and checks the spec's clamping, earlier-segment-on-boundary, null-on-empty and NaN TypeError rules; compares against a cumulative getTotalLength workaround.

interactive.rationale: Two path presets, a distance range with output and aria-valuetext, five spec-edge buttons, segment highlight and playhead dot.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index blurb matches what this page does.

edge_cases.rationale: Negative, over-length, exact boundary, NaN and empty path are each a dedicated control with the spec rule stated.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/4787972240179200 and the SVG Paths spec section.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level conformance.json (10 assertions) covers the three methods, authored and normalised read-back, plain-object writes, empty path, base value vs CSS d, the TypeError and getPathSegmentAtLength clamping/null; 8/10 pass on Chrome 153 + flag, and the two getPathSegmentAtLength checks fail correctly because that method is absent there.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 headless via Playwright with --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI (no chrome-devtools-mcp here), 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: slider scrubbed on both shapes, all five edge buttons pressed; telemetry asserts matches-workaround, boundary-earlier, nan-typeerror and empty-null all true; console clean, no overflow.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts segment-at-length-matches-workaround, -boundary-earlier, -nan-typeerror, -empty-null when native exists; segment-at-length-unsupported-fallback otherwise.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables for colour; inverted buttons set both background and color; contrast follows the existing AA pairs.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons/select/range with labels, aria-pressed toggles, visible focus outlines, role=img drawings with titles, polite status readouts.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both classes tested at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; no overflow; screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on real Chrome 160 / Canary with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Verification used headless Chrome 153 + Playwright because chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable here; the accessibility tree was not inspected. Re-run on 160 and inspect the tree for the role=img drawings and button groups.

openQuestions.title: Confirm default-on behaviour in Chrome 160 without a flag
openQuestions.detail: The native branch was verified on Chrome 158 behind --enable-blink-features=SVGPathDataAPI (all four edge asserts passed). Re-run on a stable Chrome 160 with no flags.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible SVG graphics role img description
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give visual-only SVG output an accessible name/description and expose state changes as text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each drawing is role=img with a <title>; every visual change is mirrored in a polite role=status readout.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let controls wrap, keep 44px targets and keep content within its container on narrow screens.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Control groups flex-wrap inside auto-fit grids; all buttons/selects/ranges are >=44px tall; long d strings use overflow-wrap:anywhere.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: scrollWidth === innerWidth at 360x740 on every concept, both flag states.

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider input accessible live output
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use a labelled native input type=range, expose the formatted value in DOM and aria-valuetext.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native range with <label> + <output>, aria-valuetext updated on every query, accent-color only styling, 44px block size.

guidanceConsulted.query: findings list long inline code wrapping on narrow screens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Search returned text-layout guidance aimed at short headings; nothing applies to a plain findings list.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception: content-only change (findings list and one banner sentence) using the page's existing styles; checked for overflow instead.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth = 0 at 360x740 after the edit.

summary: Built and verified headless on Chrome 153 with and without SVGPathDataAPI; real API paths exercised where the build exposes them, honest unsupported states otherwise.
